name: Olhão
mandate: PrompTugal.news Olhão: AI and technology in Olhão, a fishing port and Ria Formosa town where the sea, aquaculture and biotech lead, and what reaches Olhão from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Olhão is a fishing port on the Ria Formosa, and its technology story runs through the sea. The fish-farming pilot station of IPMA, the collaborative laboratory S2AQUAcoLAB and the aquafeed company SPAROS sit in the municipality, and a Blue Hub for the sea economy is being built in the fishing port. The AI path is real but narrow: precision nutrition and digital aquaculture, plus a council that has talked of AI for waste routes.

look.motif: tidal blue, fish scales, the white cubist rooftops and the boats of the Ria

ai_news.title: Algarve 2030 conference in Faro on 24 November: AI and water management
ai_news.summary: The Programa Regional Algarve 2030, with the newspaper Publico, holds the third conference of its water cycle at the University of Algarve, Campus da Penha, Faro, from 14:00 to 18:00. Panels cover smart water management and smart cities; speakers include water utilities, the Portuguese Environment Agency and municipalities. Olhao is not named in the article.
ai_news.ai_path: An AI event in Faro, one town from Olhao, open to the region's municipalities.

ai_news.title: Olhão school project recreates local legends with AI in an Erasmus+ exchange
ai_news.summary: Students and teachers from Olhão, Germany and Spain finished the Erasmus+ project Be Creative, Feel Legendary 2.0 in Olhão from 6 to 13 October. The legends of Olhão, Catalonia and Germany were recreated with artificial intelligence.
ai_news.ai_path: A school at Agrupamento de Escolas Dr. Francisco Fernandes Lopes used AI directly to recreate legends. A small school-level use, not a company or policy.

ai_news.title: Sparos, the Olhão feed company, sells digital nutrition tools for fish farms
ai_news.summary: Postal profiles Sparos, based in Olhão: its Digital Nutrition area collects and analyses data to recommend feeding plans, with HatchTools (a web app for hatcheries) and OptiFeeSH (a feeding-plan module for the AquaManager software, with Greek firm I2S). It uses algorithms to predict feed needs by growth stage.
ai_news.ai_path: Data-driven prediction of feed needs by algorithm, from the company that also holds the PRR project IA@SPAROS. The article does not say AI.

ai_news.title: Algarve EduTalks in Sao Bras de Alportel: 150 people discuss digital safety and the use of AI in schools
ai_news.summary: The education days on 21 February 2026 brought together experts, school heads, mayors, police, child-protection commissions, teachers, parents and students. Topics included digital safety, technological literacy and the use of AI.
ai_news.ai_path: AI use in education was a named debate topic at an event in a neighbouring municipality.

ai_news.title: Olhão's aquaculture lab leads a EUR 2.1 million digital project and awaits its new Blue Hub home
ai_news.summary: S2AQUAcoLAB marked five years in 2026. It leads DigiATLA, a European project on digital skills and precision nutrition in Atlantic aquaculture, and its new headquarters is under construction at the Hub Azul in Olhão's fishing port.
ai_news.ai_path: The lab lists AI among its research lines (2022 report), and DigiATLA brings Industry 4.0 and precision nutrition to fish farms, the same ground where SPAROS is adding AI. The article itself does not mention AI.

ai_news.title: AquaVAN mobile lab to serve Sotavento fish farms, with focus on the Ria Formosa
ai_news.summary: S2AQUAcoLAB, based in Olhão, is deploying AQUAVan, a mobile laboratory funded by MAR2030 (about EUR 170,000), to give on-site diagnosis, climate-adaptation support and training to aquaculture producers. The project is due to finish in December 2026.
ai_news.ai_path: Field diagnostics and data from fish farms feed the digital aquaculture work S2AQUAcoLAB leads (DigiATLA). The article mentions no AI or digital tools, only molecular diagnostics.

ai_news.title: DigiATLA kicks off in Olhão: seven partners start work on digital aquaculture
ai_news.summary: Partners from Portugal, Spain, France and Ireland met at the S2AQUA facilities in Olhão on 3 and 4 February 2026 and visited the fish-farming pilot station. The project plans digital training, an online knowledge repository and pilot demonstrations of Industry 4.0 tools.
ai_news.ai_path: Digital and Industry 4.0 tools for fish farms, led from Olhão with SPAROS (which runs its own AI project) as a partner. Neither the programme nor Barlavento mentions AI.

ai_news.title: Conference at Olhão's library asks what AI means for health, economy and education
ai_news.summary: The Rotary Club of Olhão held a free conference on AI and society at the Mariano Gago municipal library, with the council's support and a panel for each of the three areas.
ai_news.ai_path: An event about AI itself, held in Olhão.

ai_news.title: Olhão joins the national smart-cities section and says it is working on AI for waste routes
ai_news.summary: The council joined the leadership of the municipal association's smart-cities section in January 2023 and said it was working on smart parking and on using AI to optimise urban waste collection routes.
ai_news.ai_path: A council stating it uses AI to plan waste collection. A 2023 statement of intent: we found no later report on its progress.

ai_news.title: Altice Labs opens its Algarve hub in Olhão with an AI retina project already running
ai_news.summary: The Olhão hub opened in May 2021 with projects under way alongside the University of Algarve, among them AI algorithms for retina study.
ai_news.ai_path: An R&D hub in Olhão reporting AI work directly. Older than 2025: we found no later update.

ai_map.name: SPAROS Lda
ai_map.what: Aquafeed company in Olhão with a PRR-funded project, IA@SPAROS, to bring AI tools into feed production and into decisions on data, science and administration.
ai_map.ai_path: Its own PRR project adds AI to production and decision support.

ai_map.name: S2AQUAcoLAB
ai_map.what: Collaborative laboratory for sustainable and smart aquaculture, founded in 2021 and based in Olhão. It lists technological developments, from robotics to AI, among its research lines, and leads DigiATLA.
ai_map.ai_path: Names AI as a research line (2022 report); leads digital aquaculture work.

ai_map.name: DigiATLA
ai_map.what: Interreg Atlantic Area project (1 January 2026 to 30 June 2028, about EUR 2.13 million) on digital capacity and precision nutrition in aquaculture, led by S2AQUA with SPAROS, IPMA and universities in Vigo, Galway and France.
ai_map.ai_path: Industry 4.0 and precision nutrition in fish farming, with SPAROS (AI project of its own) as a partner. The official page does not mention AI.

ai_map.name: IPMA, Estação Piloto de Piscicultura de Olhão (EPPO)
ai_map.what: National pilot fish-farming station at Marim in the Ria Formosa Natural Park, for research, pilot-scale demonstration and technology transfer to industry.
ai_map.ai_path: Hosts the lab where AI and digital aquaculture research is tested. Its page mentions no AI.

ai_map.name: Altice Labs, Olhão hub
ai_map.what: Altice Labs opened its Algarve hub in Olhão on 12 May 2021. Projects were already running, some with the University of Algarve, including AI algorithms for studying the retina.
ai_map.ai_path: Reported AI work on retina images with the University of Algarve (2021 report).

ai_map.name: Câmara Municipal de Olhão
ai_map.what: Council that said in 2023 it was working on AI-optimised waste routes and smart parking, and in 2026 launched the digital commerce project Olhão com Alma.
ai_map.ai_path: Stated use of AI for waste collection routes (2023).

ai_map.name: FULGUR-IT
ai_map.what: Technology-based company in Olhão with solutions for agriculture, industry and smart cities, per its Portugal 2020 funding record for an internationalisation diagnosis.
ai_map.ai_path: Sensor and smart-city platforms generate the data that AI analytics runs on. We found no claim of AI in its own products: a weak, 3-step entry kept until its site is read.

ai_map.name: Algarve Innovation and Technology Park (PPPITA), Pechão
ai_map.what: Planned 48.58 hectare park in Pechão for technology companies, education and research, health and green space, with land for 548 public homes. A contract signed in August 2024 started its detailed plan, with 18 months for the landowner to finalise it. Whether it has progressed since is not confirmed.
ai_map.ai_path: A site meant for technology companies, where AI firms could locate. The article names no AI sector: a 3-step entry, labelled as a plan.

ai_map.name: Sparos: Digital Nutrition (HatchTools, OptiFeeSH)
ai_map.what: The Olhao feed company's data tools: HatchTools, a web app for hatcheries that suggests feeding plans, and OptiFeeSH, a feeding-plan module for the AquaManager software built with I2S of Greece.
ai_map.ai_path: Algorithms predict feed needs by growth stage; no explicit AI claim in the article.

ai_map.name: AQUAVan (S2AQUAcoLAB)
ai_map.what: Mobile laboratory for Sotavento fish farms, funded by MAR2030 (about EUR 170,000), due to finish in December 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Support service for the aquaculture sector S2AQUAcoLAB is digitalising; article mentions no AI.

ai_map.name: Agrupamento de Escolas Dr. Francisco Fernandes Lopes
ai_map.what: Olhao school group that hosted the Erasmus+ project Be Creative, Feel Legendary 2.0, where local legends were recreated with AI.
ai_map.ai_path: Students used AI directly in a school project (October 2026).

ai_map.name: Startup Olhao and ANJE Hub
ai_map.what: Three-year programme from a council and ANJE protocol: entrepreneur training, school financial literacy, networking and sea-economy initiatives, with an ANJE Hub in Olhao.
ai_map.ai_path: A place where AI startups could form; the article names no AI or technology sector.

extras.label: Olhão com Alma
extras.value: Digital commerce project presented on 15 April 2026: local marketplace, merchant tools, smart lockers, parking support. The article does not mention AI.

extras.label: Blue Hub (Hub Azul) of Olhão
extras.value: PRR-funded sea-economy centre being built in the fishing port, by a consortium of the council, University of Algarve, IPMA, Docapesca and S2AQUAcoLAB.

extras.label: Fishing port tender
extras.value: Docapesca launched a EUR 707,000 tender in January 2026 to rehabilitate the port's quay bridges.

extras.label: Iberian Technology Summit
extras.value: First edition held in Olhão on 28 to 30 April 2023, with about 400 participants. No later edition found.

extras.label: Startup Olhão and ANJE Hub
extras.value: The council and ANJE signed a three-year protocol in June 2026 to launch a Startup Olhão project and an ANJE Hub, with the sea economy as a target sector. The article does not mention technology or AI.

extras.label: Our article
extras.value: In Olhão, the AI path runs through the fish farm (16 November 2026).

extras.label: Starting a company here (from public sources)
extras.value: 1) The council and ANJE signed a three-year protocol in June 2026 to launch Startup Olhão and an ANJE Hub, with the sea economy as a target. 2) The council has a cooperation agreement (2018) with the Franco-Portuguese Chamber of Commerce to help local firms export and French firms settle in Olhão. 3) The Blue Hub in the fishing port, run by a consortium of the council, University of Algarve, IPMA, Docapesca and S2AQUAcoLAB, will offer lab access for sea-economy firms. 4) The council has waived the business surcharge (derrama) in earlier years, per a Postal report we could not read in full: check before relying on it. We found no dedicated council business desk page: the council is at https://www.cm-olhao.pt/ (its pages showed only a loading screen to us, so no contact channel is confirmed yet).

extras.label: Franco-Portuguese chamber agreement (2018)
extras.value: The council signed it in Paris in May 2018 to support Olhão firms entering France and French firms setting up in Olhão.

gaps: No dated local AI news from 2025 or 2026 yet: the newest items are about digital aquaculture, not AI by name. To look for: council press releases, S2AQUAcoLAB and SPAROS announcements.
Postal do Algarve blocks bots and the council site (cm-olhao.pt) showed only a loading screen, so neither was read. No RSS feeds found.
No upcoming AI events found in Olhão; the council's agenda and the Blue Hub's opening should be checked.
Whether the Blue Hub opened as planned in June 2026 is not confirmed by any source we found.
Altice Labs Olhão: confirmed as of 2021 only; no current update found on its AI work.
A Startup Olhão scheme and an ANJE Hub are planned (June 2026): once they publish members or programmes, any AI startups there belong on the map.
FULGUR-IT is on the map at 3 steps only: we have not read the company site or found an AI claim.

Not verified: a NOVA IMS training programme with AMAL and the Olhão council (smart governance, mobility data) and an Erasmus school project in Olhão using AI (Postal, October 2026, blocked to us). Both need a readable source before they count.

Investors, startups founded here and local AI talent who have spoken publicly: nothing found yet, apart from the Startup Olhão and ANJE Hub plan. Next: regional investors (such as Algarve funds and business angels) with a link to Olhão.

The council site (cm-olhao.pt) is a script-rendered app that shows no readable text to a plain fetch, so its business pages and official contact channel could not be read: a browser-based read is needed before we can link them with the date read.

Lead, not on the map: Sensaway, a Portuguese aquaculture software startup with a machine-learning project for fish farms, piloted at an Algarve farm in 2022. No source places it in Olhão, so it stays off until its base is confirmed.
Searched for council (cm-olhao.pt) AI, smart-city or waste-route news from 2025 to 2026: nothing found; site not readable and no official contact channel confirmed.
Jornal do Algarve (jornaldoalgarve.pt) returned 403 to us; its reported item 'Olhao debate impactos da inteligencia artificial nas criancas e nos jovens' could not be opened, so not counted.
Sul Informacao returned 403 on a fetch; Barlavento ?p=388855 timed out.
Searched for AI startups based in Olhao: none found. Searched for 2026 updates on Altice Labs Olhao: none found.
Moinho social innovation incubator (Postal, 19 October 2026) presented in Olhao: no AI or technology link, left off the map.
Hub Azul de Olhao: opening date still not stated in the 23 January 2026 Barlavento piece (sponsored content); digital PCR planned for shared use, no AI.
